Method of Attack: Dynamic banking overlays loaded as URLs in webview windows via Accessibility Service
Abuse of Accessibility Service to capture screenshots and keystrokes without requesting risky permissions
Screen dissection to identify installed banking apps instead of using getinstalledpackages API
Keylogger capabilities by reading screen views
Remote Access Trojan (RAT) capabilities to manipulate banking apps by tapping buttons or entering text
Reading SMS and contact lists from screen without explicit permissions
Obfuscation of internal resources using XOR and Base64 encoding
Resistance to deletion by simulating 'Back' or 'Home' button presses
Attack Vector: APK downloads from outside the Google Play Store via smishing (SMS) messages
User approval of 'downloads from unknown sources' permission
Indicators of Compromise: HTTPS sites warning about outdated Android versions offering APK updates
Use of Accessibility Service permission abuse
Dynamic overlays served from attacker-controlled command and control servers
